Messages.Author: dvorax
Messages.Body:
Abjure
Cardtype: Power
Virtue: Redemption
[COMBAT] Tap this imbued before range is determined to end a combat
between a monster and a mortal. If the mortal is a minion other than
this imbued, you may move a conviction to this imbued from your hand or
ash heap.

Can this powers efect be used by an imbued not involved in combat?

dvorax.

Messages.Author: dvorax
Messages.Body:
And another card with the same question:
Foresee
Cardtype: Power
Virtue: Vision
[COMBAT] [1 CONVICTION] Only usable before range is determined on the
first round of combat resulting from a block. Look at the opposing
minion's controller's hand. You may then choose to cancel combat. If
you do, and this imbued was blocking, the action continues as if
unblocked.

Can this be used by an imbued not involved in combat?

Messages.Author: tzimisce_dragon
Messages.Body:
i would say yes for Abjure (by card text "if the mortal is a minion
other than this imbued..." it seems
that the developers planed for this effect to be used by an imbued not
involved in the combat).
I am also not sure, but i believe that there should be explicit text to
allow the use of this "combat"
effect by a minion not involved in the combat, as normaly combat cards
(effects, e.t.c.) can only be
used by a minion involved in a combat. So, i think that they should
have mentioned this in card text.

I would say no for Foresee, as it is a combat effect and it has no
explicit card text to allow use when
not in combat. By card text ("look at the opposing minion's
controller's hand") it seems that the developers
planned for this card to be used by a minion involved in combat.

Anyway, i can't be sure, so let's wait and see what LSJ says...

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
tzimisce_dragon wrote:
[Can this card be used by an Imbued not in combat...]

> i would say yes for Abjure

> I would say no for Foresee

Correct.
